clauses.title: Scope – This clause
clauses.text: 1. Scope - This clause of Part 1 of the Standard is applicable except as follows: Addition: This Indian Standard (Part 5) specifies requirements for pliable non-flame propagating plain and corrugated conduits of insulating material. It does not include selfrecovering or flexible conduits. This standard also applies to corrugated conduits with a smooth exterior surface.

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 2. General Requirements  - This clause of Part 1 is applicable

clauses.title: General Notes on tests
clauses.text: 3. General Notes on tests - This clause of Part 1 is applicable except as follows: Replacement: The minimum total length of conduit to be submitted for all tests is 36 m. Note : Conduits of insulating materials for temperature up to 2000C are under consideration.

clauses.title: Classification – This clause
clauses.text: 4. Classification - This clause of Part 1 is applicable except as follows: 5.1 (a), (1), 5.1 (a), (3), 5.1 (b), (1), 5.1 (d), (1) 5.1 (d), (2), 5.1 (d), (3), 5.1 (c), (2), 5.1 (f), (2) and 5.1 (g), (1) (i), not applicable. Additional Sub-clause 5.101  According to temperature, given as follows:

clauses.title: Types Tests
clauses.text: 5.1 Types Tests The following shall constitute the type tests: a) Checking of admissions b) Bending test c) Compression d) Impact test e) Collapse test f) Resistance to heat g) Resistance to burning h) Electrical characteristics, and j) External influences

clauses.title: Acceptance Tests
clauses.text: 5.1.1 Acceptance Tests The following shall constitue the acceptance tests: a) Checking of dimensions b) Bending test (at room temperature only) c) Compression test d) Collapse test e) Resistance to burning f) Electrical characteristics Note - For  detail requirements refer to the standard For detailed  information, refer to  IS 9537 (Part 5): 1983.
